briefing: Market is neutral today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 +0.2%) with no strong risk-on or risk-off signal. Cash is well above the $500 threshold with all 3 slots open, so per the risk rules we filled them with the three highest-scoring, non-overbought momentum names (MAAS, COMP, BOOT) at medium conviction rather than chasing overbought names or holding idle cash.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Momentum investing means buying stocks that are already trending upward, based on signals like RSI, MACD crossovers, and price relative to moving averages, on the theory that stocks in motion tend to stay in motion over the near term. Today's buys were chosen because they showed healthy (not overbought) bullish momentum across multiple technical signals at once.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 動能投資是指買入已經處於上升趨勢的股票，依據RSI、MACD交叉及價格與均線的關係等訊號，理論基礎是「強者恆強」，股票短期內傾向延續原有走勢。今日選入的標的是因為同時出現多項技術訊號確認健康（非超買）的上升動能。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were roughly flat today, with the S&P 500 inching up 0.2% while the NASDAQ slipped 0.3%, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to a major catalyst. No single news event stood out to drive broad moves across sectors today. In the absence of a clear directional signal, stock-specific momentum (like the names in our screener) matters more than the overall market trend.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤表現平淡，標普500微升0.2%，納指則小跌0.3%，顯示投資者在等待更明確的市場訊號，並未對重大消息作出強烈反應。市場上沒有單一新聞事件主導整體走勢。在缺乏明確方向的情況下，個股的動能表現（如本次篩選到的標的）比大盤走勢更具參考價值。
